gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer is a sans-serif with generous openings and small letters that stand almost as tall as capitals. Almendra Display adds an ornate, literary heading whose letters never seem to pinch shut.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Glass tubing bent into letters: Audiowide holds one line width throughout, with tall lowercase. Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps capitals and lowercase close in height, its rounds left open like an unlatched hook.
gen-special-elite-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab is a serif with a visibly gaping c and tall, rounded lowercase forms at any size. Special Elite fills the line with distressed type; Epunda Slab keeps things dignified.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, its letters never seeming to pinch shut. Noto Sans Khojki lets text run on smoothly, with exits wide enough to pass light and a large eye on every e.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Noto Sans Lao Looped sets words as solid blocks rather than skylines, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Audiowide brings a futuristic, tech edge, its diagonals matching its stems.
gen-fs-oswald-general-sans: Tightly knit rows give Oswald its confident, strong look. General Sans, its x-height filling the line and every bend smooth and unobstructed, lets paragraphs flow with steady pen pressure.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-kr: Noto Sans KR reads clean and contemporary, with generous curve gaps and stubby ascenders next to a big x-height. Almendra Display adds ornate, literary character, and its letters never pinch shut.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao reads modern, with an x-height pushed well above the usual and mouths that stay open. Almendra Display supplies the ornate, literary flourish, never pinching its letters shut.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Futuristic tech lettering, Audiowide draws every letter with a single constant line width. And Noto Sans Limbu, with gaping curves and tall-bodied small letters, reads approachably line after line.
gen-fs-oswald-fs-asap: Confident Oswald packs its text into tightly knit rows, with a moderate lowercase height. And Asap, a readable sans-serif, stands nearly as tall in its lowercase as its capitals.
